description: Main source file for PECI driver sample application in Zephyr RTOS, implementing temperature monitoring via PECI interface.

methods.name: peci_ping
methods.description: Sends a ping command over PECI to check connectivity.

methods.name: peci_get_tjmax
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum junction temperature from the CPU via PECI.

methods.name: peci_get_temp
methods.description: Reads the current CPU temperature via PECI.

methods.name: read_temp
methods.description: Wrapper function to read and print current temperature.

methods.name: get_max_temp
methods.description: Retrieves and prints the maximum CPU temperature.

methods.name: monitor_temperature_func
methods.description: Background thread function that periodically reads temperature.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point initializing PECI and starting temperature monitoring thread.
